November 6, 2026

Habitat for Humanity of Orange County

RE: Cash deposit of $1,500 on September 14, 2026

To whom it may concern:

On September 14, 2026, I deposited $1,500 in cash into my checking account. This money was [source of the cash, such as a family gift or the sale of a car]. It is not a loan and does not need to be repaid. I can provide [a gift letter or bill of sale] to support this.

Sincerely,

______________________
[Your name]
